topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Walking through the school corridors, the walls seem to narrate stories of my past. Here I stand, years later, not just as a student but as a parent. When I learned my child would be in the same classroom, under the guidance of the very teacher who once shaped my own thoughts and dreams, a certain warmth enveloped me. It’s like a legacy, a circle that’s come full. I can almost see glimpses of my younger self in my child’s curious eyes. I am reassured, knowing they will be inspired, nurtured, and guided in the same way I was. This is more than a school year; it's a testament to the enduring impact of a great teacher.
